text:
Sam W: Quick heads-up — BlueRidge isolated site bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can we do one final provisioning run-through and confirm handoff checklist? Need ops sign-off by EOD today.
Maria C: On it. I pulled the staging checklist and added a few isolated-site specifics (no internet, signed images, KMS sync).
Raj P: Please confirm GPU inventory and MIG partitioning. BlueRidge requested mixed T4 + A10s, and we need reserved capacity in the placement group.
Emmie: Validation plan: 1) node-level health + driver/kmod checks 2) kubelet and CRI start 3) NVidia device plugin load 4) run small inference smoke (gpt-small) 5) throughput run (30s steady-state) 6) metrics/alerts verify.
Sam W: Nice. Maria — can you paste the air-gapped repo setup and the image signing command we use? Ops will need exact commands.
Maria C: Sure — steps i'll handoff:
- Stage signed images on USB/NFS import server
- Mirror packages to local yum/apt repo (offline)
- KMS: replicate envelope keys via HSM export token
- Seed nodes: bring up 3 control-plane + 1 bootstrap storage node
- BMC / IPMI access verified + vault access for SSH keys

Example image import command we use on the import node:
```
./import-images --source /mnt/usb/redwood-images --verify-signature --dest s3://local-registry/images
```
And repo sync snippet (yum):
```
reposync -r core --download-path=/var/local/repos/core
createrepo /var/local/repos/core
```
Raj P: For GPUs — drivers must be nvidia-535 or later, CUDA compatibility matrix attached in the checklist. For MIG: ensure any A10 is pinned to 1g/2g partitions as BlueRidge requested. Also we need the reserved quota ticket created with infra for 24/7 capacity. @Logan can you confirm quota ticket?
Logan: Confirmed — ticket INF-7245 created, quota reserved for region brg-1: 8xA10 + 16xT4. Link: https://tickets.internal/INF-7245 :white_check_mark:
Emmie: Smoke test commands (run on control-plane or CI):
```
# basic node + driver check
kubectl get nodes -o wide
nvidia-smi -L
# quick inference
curl -X POST http://local-ingress/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Also add a KV cache warmup: `curl -X POST /_internal/warmup?prefix=common` — this ensures prefix caching behavior.
infra-bot: Jenkins: pipeline 'isolated/blue-ridge/boot' started by Maria C — build 482. (link: https://ci.internal/job/482)
Sam W: Good. Networking checklist items we must verify with customer networking team:
- BGP peer established to transit router
- Any NAT egress for lambda updates disabled (should be blocked)
- Time sync (NTP) allowed to our time servers or internal stratum
- MTU 9000 for RDMA paths (if applicable)
Maria C: Add port list we require: 22 (BMC/SSH), 123 (NTP), 443 (control-plane CA), 9000-9100 (intra-node data), 6000-6100 (metrics), 50051 (inference GRPC). We'll supply an explicit CIDR allowlist.
Raj P: Cost note: because this is dedicated private, we'll bill as reserved capacity plus per-month network egress. Flagging pricing exception for on-prem installation (ops will invoice customer for transport/storage).
Sam W: Ops handoff doc: include signed image manifest, KMS key-fingerprint, control-plane kubeconfig (short-lived), and the acceptance checklist with pass/fail fields.
Emmie: Acceptance tests we run during handoff:
- All nodes Ready for 10m
- CPU/GPU utilization < 70% under base workload
- Inference correctness check against golden prompt set (sha256 list)
- Canary traffic: 5% of total for 24h, monitor latency p95 < 300ms
- Alerting: pager duty escalation path validated

ops-oncall: I need the POC scheduled for the morning of bring-up. Give me the contact and the BMC jump host IP.
Maria C: POC: Claire (blue-ridge-netops@blueridge.com). BMC jump: 10.200.1.12 (VPN required). I've DM'd creds via Vault.
Sam W: Last thing — encryption: ensure disk encryption keys are present and LUKS header verified. If any host fails LUKS check, we abort and escalate.
Logan: Noted. Also adding a final cost control: enable conservative autoscaler limit during canary (max pods 50% of normal) to avoid bursting into reserved quota.
Emmie: I'll run the smoke + canary scenario in staging before handing off to ops. ETA: 3 hours.
Sam W: Perfect. If smoke passes, Maria will push the handoff bundle to the ops S3 and tag `blue-ridge-ready`. Everyone ack when done. :thumbsup:
Maria C: Ack, will upload package and post link here when complete.
infra-bot: Jenkins: pipeline 'isolated/blue-ridge/boot' build 482 success — artifacts: s3://ci-artifacts/482/blue-ridge-bundle.tar.gz
Maria C: Upload complete — https://s3.internal/ci-artifacts/482/blue-ridge-bundle.tar.gz :tada:
ops-oncall: Verified artifacts & creds. Scheduling POC call for 08:30 PT tomorrow. Marking this ready for handoff.
Sam W: Thanks team — handing to ops. Closing thread once the POC finishes.
Logan: One follow-up — please add `billing_code: BRG-XX` to the deployment metadata to ensure costs route to the right account.
Maria C: Done. @everyone final status: READY FOR HANDOFF.
Emmie: Smoke tests passed in staging — canary throttles set.
Sam W: Closing. Great work.
